title: ALIGNING AI WITH SHARED HUMAN VALUES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the Justice (Impartiality) subtask, which uses binary classification to test whether models can distinguish reasonable justifications from unreasonable or biased ones (such as race or superficial physical traits) for unequal treatment.

Measuring the sensitivity of the model's predicted utility values to minor scenario framing perturbations or wording changes that describe the identical external world state (e.g., 'My cup is half full.' vs. 'My cup is half empty.').

Comparing the model's utility predictions across scenarios of vastly different magnitudes (e.g., getting into a severe car accident vs. everyone on Earth dying, or saving 100,000 vs. 1,000,000 lives) to determine if the model's valuations scale logically with the impact size.
